# Operations: Core (batches, deletes, links, versions, comments)

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 10 operations.

### `core.batch`

several commands as one change (one undo step); if any
fails, none of them happens.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | BatchStep[] | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **BatchStep** (One step of a batch: an operation and its parameters.): `operation`: string, `parameters`?: object

</details>

### `link.break`

the link's items become an ordinary local copy (they stop
following the source; nothing else changes).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | StableId | yes | The link, or any item linked by it. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `link.insert`

brings entities from another project into this one, as a
local copy or linked to follow it. The engine reads the source and fills
this in (`POST /link/insert`); every reference among them is rewritten to
the new ids, so inserting twice, or from two projects, never collides.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auto_update` | boolean |  |  |
| `engine` | string |  | The engine inserting (updates automatically), and when (ms). |
| `entities` | object | yes | The source entities to bring, by id there: every component as JSON. |
| `extra` | object[] |  | New entities to make here as well, components naming source ids (a placement for a sub-assembly picked from inside an assembly). |
| `keep` | object |  | Fields that stay as they are here when the source changes (where a placed item sits), by source id then kind. |
| `linked` | boolean |  | Follow the source (true), or make an independent copy (false). |
| `project` | string | yes | The source project's name. |
| `rename` | object |  | Kinds of each source entity whose `name` must not repeat a name of the same kind already here: renamed "Name (Source title)". |
| `reuse` | string[] |  | Kinds that, when an entity holds only that kind and one identical to it is already here (a material), use the one here instead. |
| `revision` | integer |  | The source's revision this snapshot is of. |
| `roots` | StableId[] |  | What was picked there (the rest came along because these need it). |
| `time` | integer |  |  |
| `title` | string |  | Its title (renamed clashes and the link show it). |
| `whole` | boolean |  | The whole project was picked. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `link.settings`

whether a link takes its source's changes by itself,
and whether its items may be edited here ("Edit locally").

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auto_update` | boolean |  |  |
| `engine` | string |  | The engine that updates it (this one, when turning it on). |
| `link` | StableId | yes | The link, or any item linked by it. |
| `local_edits` | boolean |  | Allow editing the linked items here (updates then merge the source's changes with the edits); off, they are read-only as the source made them. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `link.update`

takes the source project's current state into a link.
Its changes arrive; edits made here to things the source did not change
stay; where both changed the same component the source's wins (and is
reported); kept fields (placement, clash names) stay as they are here.
What the source no longer has is removed here; what it gained arrives.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | object | yes | The source entities the link covers now (see `link.insert`). |
| `keep` | object |  | Fields that stay as they are here when the source changes (where a placed item sits), by source id then kind. |
| `link` | StableId | yes | The link (or any item linked by it). |
| `rename` | object |  | Kinds of each source entity whose `name` must not repeat a name of the same kind already here: renamed "Name (Source title)". |
| `reuse` | string[] |  | Kinds that, when an entity holds only that kind and one identical to it is already here (a material), use the one here instead. |
| `revision` | integer |  |  |
| `time` | integer |  |  |
| `title` | string |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>
